📉 What moved today, Monday 16 November

🇿🇦 The JSE Top 40 closed 0.8% lower at 103,629. Banks and insurers led the fall, down 2.4%, while industrial shares rose 0.4%.

🛢️ Brent oil fell 2.3% to about $93.64 a barrel. Gold slipped 0.4% to about $3,863.

💱 The rand eased to about R16.98 to the dollar.

What it means for you: cheaper oil helps the case for December's expected petrol cut, but a weaker rand works against it.

This week: October inflation on Wednesday and the Reserve Bank's rate decision on Thursday.

Prices are 15-minute delayed. Education, not financial advice.
